# pawIQ: canonical facts

Canonical homepage: https://www.pawiqpets.com/
Primary category: Pet Supplements (Dogs)
Products: 3-in-1 Gut Health (prebiotic + probiotic + postbiotic soft chews for dogs); Skin & Immune (skin, coat + immune support soft chews for dogs)
Coming soon: Calming Chew; Hip & Joint Chew
Primary market: United States (Canada later)
Launch sequence: Amazon first; DTC shortly after

Canonical structured data:
- Product metadata (JSON-LD): https://www.pawiqpets.com/product.jsonld
- FAQs (JSON-LD): https://www.pawiqpets.com/faq.jsonld
- Sitemap: https://www.pawiqpets.com/sitemap.xml

## Learn (educational articles)
- Index: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn
- Prebiotics vs probiotics vs postbiotics for dogs: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/prebiotics-probiotics-postbiotics-dogs (scientific definitions of each term, with ISAPP sources)
- Why do dogs eat grass?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/why-do-dogs-eat-grass (what owner surveys and vet schools say, when to call the vet, lawn chemicals)
- What Thanksgiving foods can dogs eat?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/thanksgiving-foods-dogs (which dishes are fine to share and which to skip, from AVMA, FDA and Merck)
- How cold is too cold for dogs?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/how-cold-is-too-cold-for-dogs (vet-school temperature markers, signs a dog is cold, winter paw care)
- Does daylight saving time affect dogs?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/does-daylight-saving-time-affect-dogs (what a 2025 study of pet and sled dogs found, and how to move meals and walks after the clock change)
- How do you read a dog supplement label?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/how-to-read-a-dog-supplement-label (each part of a dog supplement label explained, from AAFCO and FDA guidance)
- How do I build a daily supplement routine for my dog?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/daily-supplement-routine-for-dogs (how to fit a daily chew into meals and walks, keep it consistent and track it for your vet)
- How do you prepare your dog for boarding for the first time?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/prepare-dog-for-boarding (step-by-step first-stay timeline, vaccines, packing list and what is normal after pickup)
- How often should you bathe a dog?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/how-often-to-bathe-a-dog (how often to bathe by coat and lifestyle, a step-by-step bath and brushing tips, from vet-school and Merck guidance)
- What are omega-3s for dogs? EPA, DHA and ALA explained: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/omega-3-epa-dha-dogs (EPA, DHA and ALA in plain English: what each one is, why fish oil matters and how to find it on a label)

One-sentence summary:
pawIQ makes soft chew supplements for dogs, developed with a licensed veterinarian, starting with 3-in-1 Gut Health and Skin & Immune. It launches on Amazon in the United States first, with direct-to-consumer sales to follow.
